# Observation journal fixtures (schema version 4)

| Directory | Content |
|---|---|
| `producer/` | The RPIO producer's reference journal, copied unchanged from the RPIO repository. |
| `app/` | ScrewDetection captures: one trial per scenario, with its clock samples and metadata. |
| `fragment/` | A prefix of a long ScrewDetection run (records 1..764) spanning the first model swap. |
| `lab/` | Small journals written by `tc_testutils::journal::app::lab` for library and runtime tests. They exercise timing and Knowledge views and are not clean runs: `outside-writes` has Knowledge written outside callbacks between them and cites a history its Analysis never read. |

`app/` and `fragment/` were converted from the verified version 3 captures
(at checker commit c475bfef, `tests/fixtures/rpio_v3_app` and
`tests/fixtures/rpio_v3_fragment`) by a one-off, record-by-record conversion
to the version 4 wire format: Knowledge values became their plain field
objects (tagged Options became `null` or the value), Read and Write carry
their `Resolved` inline, End outcomes carry their evidence inline, `evidence`
is kept only on Event records, Start and Event records carry `kind`, `topic`
and the message (`detection_type` of a sensor request, `reason` of an
abort; a woken Start receives exactly the message its publication sent), and
`caused_by` is `null` or the emission. Positions, times, epochs, versions and
writers are unchanged, so every scenario keeps its records at the positions
the tests name. Each `<name>.trial.json` records the converted capture's
SHA-256 and the source capture's (`converted_from_sha256`). They stand in
until the ScrewDetection application captures version 4 journals directly.

`lab/` is regenerated by
`TC_REGENERATE_FIXTURES=1 cargo test -p tc-testutils --test journal_fixtures`,
and the same test fails when the files drift from the recipes.
